@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# EditorConfig is awesome: https://EditorConfig.org
+
+# top-most EditorConfig file
+root = true
+
+[*]
+# Change these settings to your own preference
+indent_style = space
+indent_size = 2
+end_of_line = lf
+charset = utf-8
+trim_trailing_whitespace = true
+insert_final_newline = true
+
+# Ruby files
+[*.rb]
+indent_size = 2
+
+# Crystal files
+[*.cr]
+indent_size = 2
+
+# Markdown files
+[*.md]
+trim_trailing_whitespace = false
+
+# YAML files
+[*.{yml,yaml}]
+indent_size = 2
+
+# JSON files
+[*.json]
+indent_size = 2
+
+# Shell scripts
+[*.sh]
+indent_size = 2
+
+# Makefile
+[Makefile]
+indent_style = tab
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+# Set the default behavior
+* text=auto
+
+# Explicitly declare text files
+*.txt text
+*.md text
+*.rb text
+*.cr text
+*.yml text
+*.yaml text
+*.json text
+*.sh text
+*.html text
+*.css text
+*.js text
+
+# Declare binary files
+*.png binary
+*.jpg binary
+*.jpeg binary
+*.gif binary
+*.ico binary
+*.svg binary
+*.pdf binary
+*.zip binary
+*.tar binary
+*.gz binary
+*.bz2 binary
+*.xz binary
+*.7z binary
+*.rar binary
+
+# Set line ending behavior
+*.sh text eol=lf
+*.rb text eol=lf
+*.cr text eol=lf
+*.md text eol=lf
+*.txt text eol=lf
+*.yml text eol=lf
+*.yaml text eol=lf
+*.json text eol=lf
+
+# Set diff behavior
+*.png diff=binary
+*.jpg diff=binary
+*.jpeg diff=binary
+*.gif diff=binary
+*.ico diff=binary
+*.svg diff=binary
+*.pdf diff=binary
+
+# Set merge behavior
+*.lock merge=union
+*.yml merge=union
+*.yaml merge=union
+*.json merge=union
+
+# Set export-ignore for submodules
+.gitmodules export-ignore
+.gitattributes export-ignore
